claims.statement: Thebes was a capital in the Middle and New Kingdoms and a major centre of Amun worship.
Karnak reference within ancient Thebes. This locates the existing editorial study window; it does not establish continuous occupation, temple activity or a city boundary.

evidence.note: Editorial browsing window from the Middle Kingdom through 200 CE; neither the city’s founding nor its abandonment. The site includes multiple temples and necropolises; no unchecked central point is assigned. This is Egyptian Thebes, distinct from the Greek city.
